listen_addr.description: IP address the server listens on. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

listen_port.description: UDP port to listen on (must be 53 for public DNS or a high port for testing).

domain.description: The domain (e.g., 'tunnel.example.com') you own and have configured in your DNS zone for delegation to this server.

user.description: System user to run as after binding to the port (for security).

chroot_dir.description: Chroot directory to jail the server process. Leave empty to disable chroot.

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client sessions. 0 = no limit.

max_packet_size.description: Maximum allowed packet size (in bytes). Must be between 64 and 1500. Lower values reduce fragmentation risk.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to stdout/stderr.

ttl.description: DNS response TTL in seconds (default: 60 if omitted).

mtu.description: MTU for the tun interface (default: 1280 if omitted). Must be 68–1500.

password.description: Shared secret password for client authentication. If set, clients must provide the same password.

interface_name.description: Name of the virtual tunnel interface (e.g., 'iodine0'). Defaults to 'dns0'.

ip_range.description: IPv4 subnet (e.g., '10.0.0.0/24') for assigning IP addresses to clients. Must be non-routable and not conflict with your network.

items.description: Upstream DNS resolver(s) to forward queries to. Supports multiple IPs.

forward_dns.description: List of DNS servers (IP addresses only) to use for proxying DNS requests.
